name: Deft Suture
description: Close a ragged wound with quick even stitches of qi so an ally or the self does not lose more blood.

name: Faint Trace
description: Follow the faintest trace of life through a crushed body to find where the healing must begin.

name: Firm Brace
description: Brace a broken ally with a rigid frame of qi so the body can be moved without further harm.

name: Seamless Closure
description: Draw a wide wound shut in a single seamless pass of qi so the skin of an ally or the self leaves no gap.

name: Hasty Cleanse
description: Strip a fresh poison or foul residue from a wound of an ally or the self in one rushed sweep.

name: Vein Mend
description: Rejoin a severed vein end to end with threads of qi so blood runs once more through the limb of an ally.

name: Steadfast Recovery
description: Hold a steady flow of healing qi through a grievously wounded ally for an hour until the body can hold itself together.

name: Unyielding Renewal
description: Rebuild a broken body from within while feeding it vigour so an ally rises from the brink on firm legs.

name: Radiant Restoration
description: Bathe a gravely wounded ally in radiant qi that closes every wound at once and returns bone and flesh to health.

name: Cold Hand Sense
description: Hold the cold hand of a failing patient and feel how much life still clings to the body.

name: Gift Breath
description: Give a drowning ally the healer's own breath bound in qi until the lungs take it up.

name: Chest Warm
description: Spread warmth across the chest of a cold ally so the stilled heart is eased toward beating.

name: Quiet Cradle
description: Hold a dying ally in a hush of still qi that keeps the last thread of life from being shaken loose.

name: Ember Rekindle
description: Blow healing qi into the fading warmth of a body like breath on an ember until it glows again.

name: Lifeline Cord
description: Run a cord of qi from the healer's heart to a patient's and lend the stronger beat to the weaker.

name: Slipping Hold
description: Catch a life that is slipping away by gripping the heart's rhythm with qi and refusing to let it fall.

name: Persistent Return
description: Pull an ally back over the edge of death with a long unbroken call of qi inside the short window before life is lost.

name: Unrelenting Vigil
description: Stay at the bedside of a dying ally and feed the body healing qi without pause until it turns toward life.

name: Dawnfire Revival
description: Raise a bright dawn of qi inside the chest of an ally who has just died and drive the life back into the body.

name: Spring Warmth
description: Let a spring of warm qi well up from the palm and run over the hurts of an ally or the self.

name: Cool Rill
description: Run a brook of cool qi along a limb from shoulder to fingertip and carry the pain out of it.

name: Sweep Sense
description: Pass a broad sweep of awareness over a line of wounded to learn which of them need the healer first.

name: Soft Canopy
description: Raise a soft canopy of qi over the wounded that turns away small stones and loose debris.

name: Even Cheer
description: Pass a steady glow of heartening qi through the wounded in turn so their spirits and breathing level.

name: Bounty Mend
description: Let a generous stream of qi fall on several wounded at once and close their lesser cuts together.

name: Shared Strength
description: Spread the healer's own stamina evenly across the weary allies in reach so none of them falls behind.

name: Eddy Rinse
description: Turn a slow eddy of clean qi through the field to draw taint off every ally standing within.

name: Teeming Recovery
description: Let the field teem with healing qi so that many wounded recover together at the pace of the healer's breath.

name: Abundant Salve
description: Gather a vast store of salving qi and release it over a field of wounded in one great quenching wave.

name: Wellspring Mending
description: Open a wellspring of healing qi at the healer's feet that mends every ally standing in the field for as long as it flows.

name: Curse Sense
description: Probe a patient with qi for the heavy chill that shows a curse and mark where it lies.

name: Lint Press
description: Press a pad of soft qi onto a weeping sore to blot the corruption and ease an ally or the self.

name: Pure Screen
description: Raise a plain screen of qi so the taint thrown off a patient does not drift back onto the healer.

name: Hex Lift
description: Take hold of a lingering hex on an ally and lift it off the body like a cloak.

name: Meridian Flush
description: Flush the meridians of an ally or the self with clean qi until the sludge of old taint runs out.

name: Residue Scour
description: Scour the last stubborn residue of a poison from the organs of an ally or the self.

name: Deep Absolution
description: Reach into the deepest tissue of an ally and release every hidden taint and curse in a long patient pass.

name: Backlash Quell
description: Smother the scorching backlash of a shattered breakthrough in the meridians of an ally before it spreads to the heart.

name: Absolving Purge
description: Sweep a wing of white qi through the body of an ally to strip every curse and poison without a trace.

name: Channel Sense
description: Trace each meridian of a patient with qi to find where the flow is cut off or leaking.

name: Meridian Warm
description: Warm a cold meridian with steady qi until it runs freely again in an ally or the self.

name: Flow Ease
description: Loosen a clenched meridian with a patient pulse of qi so the blocked flow of an ally resumes.

name: Dantian Rest
description: Cup a hand over the dantian of a drained ally and let it fill slowly with borrowed qi.

name: Channel Reknit
description: Rejoin a torn stretch of meridian strand by strand so the qi of an ally or the self runs through.

name: Dantian Mend
description: Seal a cracked dantian with a lattice of healing qi so the reserve of an ally stops draining away.

name: Pathway Clear
description: Clear scar tissue and dead qi from a blocked pathway so the meridian of an ally opens fully.

name: Meridian Reweave
description: Weave a collapsed meridian back into a working network with long threads of patient qi in an ally or the self.

name: Dantian Recovery
description: Rebuild the walls of a damaged dantian slowly from within until it holds the qi of an ally again.

name: Meridian Renewal
description: Pour a full river of healing qi through the whole meridian network of an ally and renew every channel in it.

name: Soft Gauge
description: Rest a hand lightly upon a patient and take the measure of the body without waking it.

name: Kind Hand
description: Hold a kind hand against a hurt and send a slow even stream of qi that eases an ally or the self.

name: Mild Salve
description: Brush a mild wash of qi over a sore place so the pain of an ally or the self is gone.

name: Tender Mending
description: Mend the deepest bruise of an ally or the self so lightly that no new pain is felt.

name: Mild Rinse
description: Rinse the lingering ill from the blood of an ally with a gentle cool flow of qi.

name: Soft Rally
description: Rouse a weary ally with the smallest effective push of qi that restores the will to stand.

name: Compassionate Touch
description: Lay a compassionate hand on the worst of a wound and let the healing flow there without strain.

name: Merciful Cleansing
description: Cleanse the taint of an ally so slowly and kindly that the body gives up the poison without a spasm.

name: Tender Resurgence
description: Raise a body from deep exhaustion and wounds with qi so gentle that the ally wakes whole and rested.

name: Zephyr Salve
description: Waft a salve of cooling air-borne qi over a hurt to ease an ally or the self.

name: Wind Gauge
description: Let a breath of qi flow past a patient and feel which wounds turn the current.

name: Updraft Guard
description: Whip up a sharp gust that bats thrown grit and cinders from the face of a wounded ally.

name: Gale Mending
description: Drive healing qi into a wound on a steady gale so the flesh of an ally or the self draws in.

name: Windwash Cleanse
description: Wash a patient in a stream of moving qi that carries taint away from the body of an ally.

name: Sweeping Rally
description: Sweep a surge of qi down the line of weary allies so each of them finds a second wind.

name: Sweeping Recovery
description: Sweep healing qi across the wounded on the wind and close their hurts one after another along the line.

name: Tempering Mercy
description: Temper a battered ally with healing and a hardening gust of qi so the wounded body bears the next blow.

name: Gale Mercy
description: Send a great gale of mercy over the wounded that lifts pain and knits flesh across the whole company.

name: Clear Gauge
description: Take a clear measure of a patient's wounds in the open light with a single sweep of the palm.

name: Sunlit Touch
description: Lay a hand bright with qi on a hurt and watch the wound draw warmth and close.

name: Airway Open
description: Open the throat and lungs of a gasping ally with cool qi until the breath runs deep.

name: Sky Screen
description: Hang a wide pale screen of qi over the wounded to deflect falling debris.

name: Sunlit Mending
description: Mend a deep cut under a beam of bright qi that makes the flesh of an ally knit visibly.

name: Bright Cleanse
description: Burn the dark taint out of a body with a lens of bright qi until the ally breathes clean.

name: Heart Kindling
description: Strike a spark of qi into a faltering heart so the beat of an ally returns strong.

name: Returning Breath
description: Breathe a surge of qi into a lifeless ally to bring the first breath back before the window shuts.

name: Open Sky Mending
description: Mend every wound of a broken ally in plain view with a pillar of clear healing qi from the sky above.

name: Skybright Revival
description: Call a brilliant column of qi down upon an ally lately dead and wake the heart and breath in one stroke.

name: Pledge Touch
description: Make the pledged touch of a mender on a wound so that it closes under a steady pulse of qi.

name: Oath Gauge
description: Hold the oath in mind and sense which ally in the company is nearest to death.

name: Mending Screen
description: Raise a pledged screen of qi that holds against blows for the length of the mending.

name: Oathbound Mending
description: Bind the healer's word into the qi of the mending so it runs on until the ally has recovered.

name: Sworn Rinse
description: Rinse a sworn comrade's blood of taint and refuse to stop until the last trace is gone.

name: Resolve Lend
description: Lend a failing ally a measure of the healer's own resolve in qi so the will to endure returns.

name: Faithful Restoration
description: Restore a wounded sworn ally through the whole night with unwavering qi and no change in the healer's hand.

name: Steadfast Revival
description: Hold the oath firm and recall a freshly fallen ally to the body with one resolute call of qi.

name: Unbroken Mercy
description: Pour mercy without limit into a wounded ally for as long as it takes and let no tiredness break the flow.

name: Heading Gauge
description: Take a bearing on the stain of taint in a patient's body so the cleansing can be aimed.

name: Cool Draft
description: Send a cool draft of qi through a feverish body to carry the heat from an ally or the self.

name: Slumber Touch
description: Lull a spasming muscle with a light touch and a drift of qi so the cramp of an ally eases.

name: Wind Cushion
description: Hold a cushion of moving air round a wounded ally so jolts and chill are turned away.

name: Easy Breath
description: Ease the breathing of a labouring ally with a steady current of clean qi at the mouth.

name: Tailwind Mend
description: Push healing qi along the body of an ally on a following wind so the mending hastens.

name: Draft Cleanse
description: Draw a draft of clean qi through a tainted body and out at the wound to carry the foulness off.

name: Bearing Rally
description: Set a faltering ally on a steady heading with a burst of qi and a word so the legs hold.

name: Windborne Recovery
description: Carry healing qi across a wide company on a steady wind so each wounded ally recovers at once.

name: Steady Purification
description: Hold a fixed bearing of clean wind through a field of tainted wounded until every body runs clear.

name: Zephyr Purge
description: Loose a bright wind through the field that scours curse and venom from every ally it touches.

name: Extended Hand
description: Stretch a thread of healing qi across a few paces to ease the hurt of a wounded ally.

name: Distant Gauge
description: Cast the senses outward to feel how each scattered casualty fares before walking to them.

name: Sweeping Hush
description: Pass a hush of calming qi over a company in pain so the groans quieten and the breathing slows.

name: Fair Wind
description: Ease the pace of a long march for the weak with a following draught of vigour.

name: Lengthy Mend
description: Draw a long wound shut over many breaths with a thin continuous thread of qi.

name: Gale Rinse
description: Blow a long gale of clean qi across a poisoned ally and strip the venom from the skin.

name: Far Mercy
description: Send mercy as a ribbon of qi across the gap to close the worst wound of a distant ally.

name: Lingering Salvation
description: Leave a lingering web of healing qi on a wounded ally that keeps mending the body long after the healer moves on.

name: Distant Succour
description: Cast a great sweep of healing qi to wounded allies at the far end of the company.

name: Windswept Restoration
description: Let a long gale of restoring qi sweep across a scattered company and close the wounds of every ally it passes.

name: Broad Salve
description: Spread a broad sheet of salving qi over a scraped back or flank to soothe an ally or the self.

name: High Sense
description: Lift the senses above the body and take in all its hurts as one picture.

name: Level Screen
description: Hold a level screen of qi over the patient to keep the work free from interruption.

name: Steady Mending
description: Mend with an unhurried hand whose rhythm never changes until the wound of an ally has closed.

name: Crisp Cleanse
description: Cut a clean line through a body's taint with sharp bright qi and leave the flesh clear.

name: Hardy Rally
description: Harden a worn ally's limbs with a single surge of qi so the body will not give way.

name: Lofty Recovery
description: Raise a body from the verge of ruin with the whole high strength of a master mender's qi.

name: Exalted Revival
description: Spend the full reserve of a master mender to bring an ally back in the short window after the heart stops.

name: Lofty Renewal
description: Pour the whole high art of the menders into one patient and make the body new from the bones outward.
